lines.text: For a hundred years, work looked like this,
From the punch clock to the corner office, one rule: be in the room.
But where and how we work has changed.
Instead of one office, we now have many: laptops, phones, kitchen tables, three time zones before lunch.
Work has come a long way,
We still call everyone in at nine, to say out loud what we could simply show.
Hours of status updates. Lots of talking, very little making.
So let's tear up the nine o'clock status meeting,
and start showing the work instead.
Work today should be visible, not reported.
Progress should be shared the moment it happens.
And every meeting should earn its place.
That's why we built Open-fold: one living page where your team's work shows itself.
